message.reasoning:
I've got $362 in cash and my pink properties are all at 4 houses each. If I build hotels, the houses return to the bank and that ruins my shortage strategy. So I'm stuck — I can't build more without losing the advantage I'm trying to maintain.

I'll just end my turn here. With only 8 houses left in the bank, the scarcity is already working in my favor, and building hotels would release 12 houses back into circulation. Better to keep things as they are.
